purpose: Phase-7C structured immune-suppression model. Suppression = reduced immune EFFECTIVENESS, kept DECOMPOSED into named separable components (never one opaque constant) and combined into a bounded total. Section 1 establishes the contract + double-counting rules; calculation is a later section (UNAVAILABLE for now). Schematic normalized [0,1]; no cytokine / suppressive-factor concentration (NOT_REPORTED).

aggregation.note: total = 1 - PRODUCT over components of (1 - w_i * s_i); bounded [0,1], avoids naive summation. Weights + any correlation discounts are defined when the biology section is implemented.

coefficient_policy.source: general immunosuppressive-TME biology applied predictively; hypoxia/vascular components derive READ-ONLY from Phase-7A / Phase-7B outputs
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: each component is a named ledger entry so suppression can be inspected and audited for double counting.

double_counting_rules.hypoxia_once: hypoxia-associated suppression is applied once even if hypoxia also lowered vascular oxygen supply upstream.
double_counting_rules.checkpoint_once: checkpoint suppression already captured in CD8 exhaustion is not re-added unchanged.
double_counting_rules.treg_decomposed: Treg suppression is a named component, not duplicated in a generic tumour-derived term.
double_counting_rules.vascular_access_once: poor perfusion reduces immune access once; it is not re-applied through an identical vascular term.
